A_recent_qb_workload.method: Shrink last3 or last5 current-team attempts/dropbacks toward prior league QB opportunity, 2 prior games weight; history prior-team fallback only with accepted team assignment

B_team_volume.method: Prior last3 or last5 team plays × ratio-of-sums dropbacks/plays × accepted expected QB share × league attempts/dropback

C_opponent_environment.method: B plus shrunk opponent allowed plays/dropback-rate residual; opponent offensive possession volume enters plays only, never efficiency

D_qb_conversion.method: B opportunity with prior QB attempts/dropbacks shrunk by 50 or100 dropbacks toward prior league conversion; sacks/scrambles explicitly reconciled

E_starter_role.method: Accepted state categories; current-team QB history → prior-team QB history → team → league, sample-based shrinkage; abstain if expectation absent

F_script_scenarios.classification: Prior plays <55 LOW / >75 HIGH; otherwise >half nonneutral historical offensive plays lead>7 TEAM_LEADS or trail<-7 TEAM_TRAILS; remainder competitive. No target-script label.
F_script_scenarios.method: Empirical means of prior team-game plays/rate in five scenarios, shrink each at5 games toward league same-scenario; fixed empirical prior frequencies with5 league pseudo-games, no realized target script

G_coherent_chain.method: Combine only separately passed plays/rate/share/conversion components; no failed-family blends

blocked_run: Produce audit, frozen benchmark definition, explicit NOT_RUN source-block lock/results and 2024 uncertain-state raw receipt ledger. No model performance or oracle metrics manufactured.

bootstrap.method: Paired 14-calendar-day moving-block of complete games; never row-wise

censor_rule.clean: CENSORED_IN_GAME only independently documented injury/ejection/abnormal removal with source receipt; no accepted archive currently, status UNKNOWN_NOT_CENSORED
censor_rule.raw: Retain all raw official realized labels; no censor by attempts/share/poor performance
censor_rule.unavailable: No clean full-game subset can be claimed without accepted abnormal-exit labels

chronology.confirmation: 2025 only if source and development gates pass; selection-free for L, not globally untouched by prior phases
chronology.diagnostic: 2026 W1-4 burned only after 2025 independent attempt gate; no selection
chronology.future: 2026 Week5+ forbidden; blocked runner opens no 2025/2026 payload
chronology.refit: Selected surviving specification only, all eligible 2024

comparators: V1/Phase1C analytic/frozen opportunity on same cohort (never simulate; unavailable is explicit)
recent3 team plays × recent3 dropback rate × prior share × prior conversion
frozen Week4 workload3 × efficiency8 opportunity component

competent_human.conversion: last5 QB across-team attempts/dropbacks, 50 prior league dropbacks
competent_human.dropback_rate: last3 current-team sum dropbacks / sum plays, 100 league prior plays
competent_human.league: strict prior most recent128 team-games, no target week
competent_human.plays: last3 current-team mean plays, two league prior games
competent_human.share: accepted expected QB only; last3 current-team QB dropbacks / team dropbacks, 20 prior dropbacks at share1 for an explicit single starter; no guessed assignment

components: QB share MAE predicted vs actual

oracle: POSTGAME_ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY after normal workload evaluation; actual attempts × frozen YPA, predicted attempts × actual YPA, actual plays × predicted rate, predicted plays × actual rate. Never fit/select/promote.

population.candidate_receipts: All prior-known QB identities with a dropback in last8 legal current-team games, regardless target participation. Cold-start absence represented by team-level insufficient row. 2024 audit ledger only; no scored primary if source gate fails.
population.change: SECONDARY_STARTER_CHANGE: accepted current expectation with explicit dated role/change reason; never inferred from target passer
population.insufficient: EMERGENCY_OR_CENSORED: insufficient prior identity evidence; no easy-zero headline promotion
population.multi: MULTI_QB: explicit pregame package roles, not retrospective two-passer counts
population.primary: PRIMARY_STABLE_STARTER: accepted asof state and same expected QB dominating two prior completed current-team games (>=80% QB dropbacks each, >=20 attempts per game), current health/role evidence without contradiction
population.uncertain: UNCERTAIN: prior candidates exist but current expectation, health or membership unresolved

promotion.2026: No >0.5 attempt MAE regression versus strongest baseline or >2pp catastrophic worsening; diagnostics not selection
promotion.component_guards: No >0.5 plays/dropback MAE worsening, >1pp pass-rate/share/conversion worsening, or >1pp >15/>20 attempt-miss worsening versus strongest comparator
promotion.development_and_2025: Attempt MAE reduction >=max(1.0 attempt,5% strongest required transparent/incumbent comparator MAE), upper95% paired delta <0; fixed matched candidate keys
promotion.family_gate: Claimed component must improve independently; G only all listed parents passed
promotion.yard_gate: Only after 2025 attempt gate and permitted diagnostic, unchanged incumbent YPA; no cancellation promotion

source_gate.required: Accepted authorized pregame expected-starter/depth plus health versions covering 2024 development and 2025 confirmation; stable game/team/GSIS joins; original published/observed/revision timestamps before cutoff
source_gate.stop: BLOCKED_STARTER_STATE_DATA before any fitting/scoring if primary stable starter population cannot be certified. Prior passer dominance is a hint, never current starter certification. Do not relax the gate to run models.
source_gate.unblock: NEW protocol required after data acceptance; this frozen blocked runner cannot automatically reopen

target: Official QB pass attempts first; opportunity dropbacks include spikes; yards gated on independent workload success
temporal_rule: Strict earlier season/week AND source game-date +48h <= target game-date -24h UTC00:00. Corrected PBP is not an original vintage archive. State receipts require published AND observed <= cutoff with revision history. No current target-game participant, script, attempts, starter or outcome as feature.
